messages.label: scam
messages.text: AIB: We have declined a card transaction of €1,250.00 at CURRYS ONLINE. If this was not you, contact our Fraud Department immediately on [number]. Do not reply to this text.
messages.note: Hard: looks like a real fraud alert, but gives its own number to ring, which leads to a fake fraud team.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: This is Bank of Ireland security. We've spotted a login from a new device, so we need to verify your phone. Open your keypad and dial star 21 star followed by the number I give you, then press call. Please stay on the line while it registers.
messages.note: Fake bank asks you to dial a *21* code, which forwards your calls to the criminal.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Mrs Kelly, your debit card has been used in Spain this morning, it's compromised. A driver from our security team will call to your house in the next hour to take the card away. Pop it in an envelope, and I'll just need your PIN to cancel it on our side.
messages.note: Fake bank arranges for a courier to collect the card and asks for the PIN.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: An Post: Your parcel from overseas is being held due to an unpaid import charge of €3.00. Pay now to release it for delivery, or it will be returned to sender: [link]
messages.note: Customs-charge text with a payment link; An Post never sends payment links by text.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: eFlow Notice: An unpaid toll has been recorded for your vehicle on the M50. Settle today to avoid a fine and possible court proceedings: [link]
messages.note: Fake toll text with a link and a threat of prosecution.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Revenue: You are eligible for a tax refund of €512.40 for 2025. To receive your refund, verify your bank details through the secure link below within 3 days. [link]
messages.note: Revenue does not send refunds by email link and won't ask for bank details this way.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: hiya mam its me, smashed my phone so using a mates one for now. can you text me back on this number, need to ask you something xx
messages.note: Hard: unknown number claiming to be a child, no money asked yet; the usual opener.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Good afternoon, this is Garda O'Neill from the Economic Crime Bureau. Your account is linked to a fraud case we are investigating. Please send us your bank name, IBAN and the last four digits of your card so we can rule you out today.
messages.note: WhatsApp message posing as a Garda asking for bank details.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hi, the 2-bed in Rathmines is still available at €900 a month. I'm living in Spain now so I can't do a viewing, but if you send the deposit today I'll courier the keys and contract. Lots of interest so I need an answer by tonight.
messages.note: Hard: friendly landlord abroad, no viewing, rushes the deposit.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Easy money for students 💸 We pay €300 a week to people who let our clients' payments come into their bank account and transfer them on. Totally legit, takes 5 mins. DM me, and don't mention it to your bank.
messages.note: Money mule recruitment: paid to pass money through your account, with secrecy.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Sponsored · Irish families are earning a guaranteed €1,000 a month from the new state-backed investment programme, as revealed on the Late Late. Limited places for over 50s. Find out if you qualify: [link]
messages.note: Ad with a fake TV endorsement for a 'state-backed' scheme with guaranteed returns.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Thanks for signing up for the paid feedback study! For your first €50, download the screen sharing app, then open your banking app so we can watch you use it. You'll get a code by text, just send it to me here to finish.
messages.note: Hard: 'paid survey' that asks to watch your banking app and get your one-time code.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: [number] is your AIB security code to approve your online payment. Never share this code with anyone, including AIB staff.
messages.note: Genuine one-time code that says not to share it.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: An Post: Sorry we missed you. Your item is waiting at your local Post Office from tomorrow after 11am. Bring the card we left and photo ID. Nothing to pay.
messages.note: Real missed-delivery notice: no link, no fee.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Your income tax return for 2025 is now available to complete. Log in to myAccount on the Revenue website yourself to review your details. Revenue will never ask for your bank details by email or text.
messages.note: Revenue-style reminder telling you to log in yourself, with no link.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Mam would you be able to lend me €60 till Thursday? The ESB bill came out before my wages. I'll pay you back when I'm down Sunday for the dinner. How's Dad's knee?
messages.note: Child's usual number with personal context and a small loan; no new number or urgency.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: We've temporarily blocked your card after an unusual transaction. Please check the alert in your banking app, or call us on the number on the back of your card. We will never ask you to move money or for your PIN.
messages.note: Genuine card block that points to the app and the number on the card.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi, saw your bike on DoneDeal. Is it still for sale? I could come and look at it Saturday morning and pay cash if it's in good nick.
messages.note: Normal buyer asking to view and pay in person.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Reminder: your appointment with Dr Walsh at Main Street Surgery is on Wed 19 Nov at 9:20. If you can't make it please ring the surgery. No reply needed.
messages.note: GP appointment reminder with no link or payment.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hiya it's Ciara from the GAA club, new phone so this is my new number. Delete the old one. See you at training Tuesday!
messages.note: Friend announcing a new number and asking for nothing.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi Seán, just confirming the rent stays at €1,450 from January as agreed at renewal. Same standing order, no change of account. Let me know if the shower's still giving trouble. Thanks, Declan
messages.note: Landlord confirming agreed rent with no change of payment details.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Your eFlow account balance is low. To top up, log in to your account on the eFlow website or app. We will never send you a link to make a payment by text.
messages.note: Toll account notice that tells you to log in yourself, with no link.
